description: This file contains unit tests for indoor navigation selection logic using NUnit in a Unity environment. It tests the hit detection of screen taps over selectable objects represented by bounds, with different tap positions to verify boundary detection.

classes.name: ISelectable
classes.description: Interface representing selectable indoor objects with an identifier and spatial bounds.

classes.name: IndoorSelectionLogic
classes.description: Static class containing logic to determine if a screen tap hits a selectable object based on scaled bounds.

classes.name: DummySelectable
classes.description: A simple implementation of ISelectable used for testing, holding an Id and Bounds.

classes.name: IndoorTouchEditModeTests
classes.description: Test fixture class containing unit tests for the selection logic, verifying hit detection for various tap positions.

methods.name: IsTapOnSelectable
methods.description: Determines if a 2D screen tap point hits a given selectable object by projecting the 3D bounds into screen space and checking for inclusion.

methods.name: IndoorTouchEditModeTests.IsTapOnSelectable_ReturnsTrue_WhenTapInsideBounds
methods.description: Test that a tap inside the bounds of the selectable object registers as a hit.

methods.name: IndoorTouchEditModeTests.IsTapOnSelectable_ReturnsFalse_WhenTapOutsideBounds
methods.description: Test that a tap outside the bounds of the selectable object is correctly identified as a miss.

methods.name: IndoorTouchEditModeTests.IsTapOnSelectable_BorderInclusive
methods.description: Test that a tap exactly on the border of bounds is considered a hit, testing boundary conditions.
